source_request: [$photo-prompt-image-generator](/Users/chasoik/Projects/image-prompt/skills/photo-prompt-image-generator/SKILL.md) 첨부한 이미지의 외모에 어울리는 북해빙궁 반로환동 쿨데레 미소녀 컨셉 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성해줘. 첨부한 이미지는 얼굴만 참고하고 구도는 자유롭게 해줘. 이 작업을 각각 독립된 환경의 서브에이전트에서 하나는 스킬을 사용하고 다른 하나는 스킬을 사용하지 않고 작업하도록 하고 두 결과를 취합하여 스킬의 성능을 평가해줘.
interpreted_intent: A cinematic photographic portrait of an ancient Northern Sea Ice Palace grandmaster restored to a youthful but unmistakably adult form, using only the attached face as appearance reference and making her cool, restrained affection legible through a protective incident with the same adult disciple.
subject: An unmistakably adult woman with the attached portrait's pale luminous complexion, softly tapered oval face, large cool-gray eyes, delicate features, tiny beauty mark beside the nose, and long ash-blonde hair with airy bangs.
setting: A moonlit corridor of a remote Northern Sea ice palace immediately after a blizzard.
event: She fastens a frost-silk wrist guard around the same adult disciple's injured hand; her eyes briefly soften, the disciple relaxes, and the cracked glove visibly seals.
visual_priorities: Facial appearance fidelity limited to the attached portrait while composition, wardrobe, and setting remain freely authored.
Single-frame readability of distant authority giving way to protective care toward one identifiable adult disciple.
baseline_prompt_en: Create a cinematic fantasy editorial photograph of an unmistakably adult woman, an ancient Northern Sea Ice Palace grandmaster restored to a youthful adult form. Her face follows the attached portrait only: pale luminous skin, a softly tapered oval face, large cool-gray eyes, straight delicate brows, a slim nose, full pale-rose lips, a tiny beauty mark beside the nose, and long ash-blonde hair with airy bangs. In a frozen moonlit palace corridor after a blizzard, she keeps an aloof, composed expression while fastening a frost-silk wrist guard around the same adult disciple's injured hand. At the instant she tightens the silver knot, her cool-gray eyes soften toward that disciple. The disciple's tense fingers visibly relax as the wrist guard seals the cracked glove with a thin crystalline sheen. Matching snow-crane emblems on the disciple's sleeve and the wrist guard establish continuity. Show glacial jade robes, restrained silver embroidery, translucent ice architecture, drifting snow, realistic skin texture, and quiet blue-white light. Prioritize facial likeness and the readable contrast between distant authority and protective care.
